messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need a concise launch-gate playbook for Hosted GA. Must cover SLA/SLO, docs, support/oncall, monitoring/alerts, and pricing. Who owns which piece?
Ben (Eng): I can own runtime SLOs. Initial proposal: availability SLA 99.9%, p95 latency <150ms, p99 <350ms for short-text models. Separate buckets for embeddings/long-context.
Sasha (Docs): +1 on buckets. Also call out error-budget policy + fallback behavior. Docs need clear examples.
Ian (Support): Support side — recommend 24/7 oncall for enterprise customers at GA, business-hours for free tier. Ops signoff needed.
ops_bot: Support rota template created: /playbooks/support-rota-v1.0. Current week oncall: @Lucy.
Lucy (Oncall): I can pilot the rota. Need runbook links + a short triage checklist. Also want explicit escalation path to Eng-SRE.
Ben (Eng): Runbook skeleton (will flesh out):
```
Checks:
1) Is request queue depth > threshold?
2) Any model fallback triggered? (model_variant != requested)
3) KV cache hit rate < 60%?
4) Are any pods OOM/killing?
```
Sasha (Docs): I'll take docs ownership: quickstart, SLA FAQ, rate-limit explainer, and migration notes for Dedicated/Private parity. Need example contract language for SLAs.
Lucy (Oncall): Monitoring needs: per-model p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, cache_hit_rate, error_rate, quota_usage. Alerts: sustained p95 breach 5m, error_rate >0.5% 3m, fallback_rate >1% 10m.
Ian (Support): Can we codify severity matrix? Sev 1 = >5% customers impacted or total throughput down. Sev 2 = degraded latency for single tier. Also define SLAs for escalation times.
Maya (PM): Pricing — tiered: starter (pay-as-you-go), committed (Dedicated discounts), enterprise (custom). Need concrete per-token and reserved discounts for GA. @Ian can you loop in pricing ops?
Ian (Support): Yep, will loop Pricing Ops and get draft by Thursday.
Ben (Eng): We also need a rollout policy: canary %s, automated rollback triggers (error_rate spike, p95 spike). Add to rollout/runbook.
Sasha (Docs): Customer asks we've seen: guaranteed tail latency on Dedicated -> propose term "Committed Tail SLA" with higher penalty tiers. I'll draft contract wording options.
Maya (PM): Summarizing action items:
```
- Runtime SLOs & rollout triggers: Ben (owner) - due Wed
- Support rota & triage runbook: Lucy + Ian - due Thu
- Docs (quickstart + SLA language): Sasha - first draft Fri
- Monitoring dashboards + alerts: Ben + Eng-SRE - prod dashboards by Thu
- Pricing tiers + draft numbers: Maya + Ian - finalize Fri EOD
- Contract SLA wording for Dedicated: Sasha + Legal - draft Fri
```
Maya (PM): Any objections? If not, I'll convert this into a launch-gate checklist in the repo and assign tickets. :white_check_mark:
